integrity: General proof by toric-component restrictions and multigraded linear independence; finite exact-rational tests for n=4..10 supplement, but do not replace, the proof. The literature priority assessment remains qualified.
scientific_limitations: Determines only the degree-two homogeneous ideal of the reduced Plucker-embedded quasisymmetric Grassmannian in rank two, for n>=4 over C; no assertion on higher-degree generators, naive presentation saturation, or infinitesimal structures.
title: Degree-two defining equations of the reduced rank-two quasisymmetric Grassmannian
